        "text": "` your account with the @Bartender#3518 bot and use the `/apply` command to get registered"
      }, {
        "text": " (or use the tourney register with ID 9).\n\n## Scheduling \u0026 Lobbies:\n- **Self-Scheduling"
      }, {
        "text": "**: Pick a date when you\u0027re comfortable playing for real and post it in the **#schedule** channel."
      }, {
        "text": " \n- **Rescheduling**: Please commit to the schedule you set. If you become a \"re-scheduling demon\", the"
      }, {
        "text": " organizers will pick a date for you or ban you.\n- **Lobby Requirements**: You must coordinate your lobby with **at"
      }, {
        "text": " least 3 registered players**. You **MAY NOT** play the qualifiers alone. This is to ensure nobody plays twice and to"
      }, {
        "text": " prevent abusing replayability. \n- **One Sitting**: The entire qualifier **MUST** be played in one sitting."
      }, {
        "text": " \n- **No Retries / Cheating**: You cannot play through the mappool twice! Our bot filters unregistered"
      }, {
        "text": " players, tracks if runs are actually completed in one sitting, and catches anyone trying to play twice. Please note that while this"
      }, {
        "text": " is not an \"official\" tournament, any workarounds or cheating will result in a **ban without appeal**. \n\n## Referees"
      }, {
        "text": " \u0026 Submitting Results:\n- Lobbies for the Qualifiers stage are entirely self-refereed. If you are acting"
      }, {
        "text": " as the referee, you will make the lobby, invite the players, and queue every map. \n- **No"
      }, {
        "text": "-shows:** If someone fails to show up on time, they\u0027ll be forced to schedule another lobby. Anyone who fails to submit"
      }, {
        "text": " a lobby or doesn\u0027t show up for the full qualifier will be disqualified.\n- **Submitting:** After you"
      }, {
        "text": " are done, send the lobby link to a referee. They will take a look and, if everything is in order,"
      }, {
        "text": " submit the lobby through the @Bartender bot. Alternatively, you can post the accessible mp link or HTML file (by"
      }, {
        "text": " saving with CTRL+S on the osu! events page) to @Rabusu.\n\n## Team Formation:\nFor"
      }, {
        "text": " those wondering how teams will be formed from the qualifier results: \nTeams will be strictly randomized after the qualified players are"
      }, {
        "text": " announced. However, we will make sure to tweak and balance the teams to ensure no team gets unfair advantages from the random"
      }, {
        "text": " mix. \n\n## Content Creation:\nFeel free to livestream your qualifier lobbies or record them to post on YouTube! It’"
      }, {
        "text": "s highly encouraged so we can have a record of the tournament to look back on, and so others can watch and learn."
      }, {
        "text": " \n\n***Thank you and good luck! Just want everyone to have fun and enjoy themselves.***\nTeam BPM and Team TH"
      }, {
        "text": "SL"
      }, {
        "text": "",
        "thoughtSignature": ""
      }],
